name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-02-20, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.77 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
